Cc: compliance@medicushealth.com
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Data residency + VPC evidence needed for procurement

Hi Mina,

Thanks for the quick onboarding so far. Our procurement and security teams are running the final validation ahead of contract signature and we need a short evidence packet that covers data residency (EU-only requirement for this workload), private connectivity, and key separation for customer data. Specifically we need: 

- A short signed residency statement confirming that Medicus tenant data for the contracted deployment will be hosted in EU regions only (please list region names and cloud provider regions).
- A network diagram showing VPC/private link topology (where data egress occurs, peering endpoints, NAT/GW configuration).
- KMS/Key-material partitioning matrix showing how_medical customer keys are isolated and whether Redwood or the customer manages keys (and any HSM usage).
- The private-connectivity runbook for initial setup and failover procedure (bullet list ok).
- A pointer to the SOC 2 section that covers logical/physical segregation or an excerpt if available.

Deadline: we need the packet by COB Monday Nov 30 to keep the procurement timeline. If part of this is under NDA and needs a secure share, please note the method.

Thanks — Linda
Linda Park
Head of Vendor Compliance, Medicus Health
linda.park@medicushealth.com

I'll take point on the VPC diagram and the private connectivity runbook. Quick notes: 
- Target hosting for Medicus will be AWS eu-west-1 (Ireland) for primary and eu-west-2 (London) only if explicitly requested; no US region for this tenant by default.

- KMS: per-tenant CMKs are supported; keys can be customer-managed via BYOK/HSM, or Redwood-managed CMKs with strict tenant usage policies. I'll include both diagrams.

- KMS: Per-tenant CMKs are supported. Table shows current key ownership options (Redwood-managed CMKs or customer-supplied BYOK with HSM). See "kms-segmentation-matrix_20261129.csv".
- Runbook: Step-by-step provisioning + failover checklist for PrivateLink + VPC peering. See "private_connectivity_runbook_20261129.md".
- SOC 2: Excerpt of the SOC 2 architecture section that references logical segregation controls is included as "soc2-section-A-arch_20261129.pdf".
